body:
Stainless Steel Outer Half Coil Reactor

Product Overview

The Stainless Steel Outer Half Coil Reactor is a customized chemical processing vessel designed for efficient heating, cooling, mixing, and temperature-controlled reactions. Manufactured by Yangzhou Tongyang Chemical Equipment Co., Ltd., this reactor features an externally welded half-pipe coil system that provides effective heat transfer and reliable thermal management.

Constructed from stainless steel 304, 316L, or other materials according to process requirements, the reactor is suitable for demanding applications in chemical processing, petrochemical production, pharmaceuticals, polymers, and specialty chemicals.

Key Features

1. Efficient Outer Half Coil Heating and Cooling

  • Externally welded half-pipe coils provide effective heat transfer between the heating or cooling medium and the reactor contents.

  • Suitable for steam, thermal oil, hot water, or chilled water, depending on operating conditions.

  • Customized coil arrangement and pitch to meet specific temperature control requirements.

  • External coil construction supports efficient thermal management without occupying internal vessel space.

2. Stainless Steel Construction

  • Available in SS304, SS316L, and other corrosion-resistant materials.

  • Designed for chemical compatibility, durability, and long-term industrial operation.

  • Surface treatment and welding requirements can be customized according to project specifications.

3. Customized Reactor Design

  • Vertical or horizontal configurations according to process requirements.

  • Optional mechanical agitation systems with customized impellers and sealing arrangements.

  • Flexible nozzle configurations for material feeding, discharge, instrumentation, and maintenance.

  • Design and fabrication according to applicable ASME or Chinese pressure vessel standards, where specified.

4. Reliable Operation and Maintenance

  • Robust structural design for industrial processing conditions.

  • Optional temperature, pressure, and liquid-level instrumentation.

  • External heating and cooling channels facilitate process temperature control.

  • Access openings and maintenance provisions can be incorporated according to equipment requirements.

Industrial Applications

The Stainless Steel Outer Half Coil Reactor is widely applicable to:

  • Chemical Industry: Polymerization, resin synthesis, specialty chemical production, and other temperature-controlled reactions.

  • Petrochemical Industry: Chemical intermediate processing, blending, and thermal treatment.

  • Pharmaceutical Industry: Chemical synthesis, intermediate production, and controlled batch processing.

  • Coatings & Adhesives: Resin manufacturing, adhesive production, and formulation processes.

  • Fine Chemicals: Batch reaction systems requiring controlled heating, cooling, and mixing.

Why Choose Tongyang?

With extensive experience in chemical equipment manufacturing, Tongyang provides customized reactor solutions supported by engineering coordination, material selection, precision fabrication, welding, inspection, and quality control.

Our manufacturing capabilities cover stainless steel reactors, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, storage tanks, and other process equipment for international industrial projects.

We support project-specific engineering requirements, including ASME design and fabrication, customized configurations, inspection documentation, and factory acceptance testing (FAT) as applicable.

Custom Stainless Steel Half Coil Reactor Solutions

Tongyang offers customized Stainless Steel Outer Half Coil Reactors based on customer process data, technical drawings, and project specifications.

Contact us with your required reactor capacity, materials, operating pressure, temperature, heating/cooling medium, and agitation requirements to receive a technical proposal and quotation.
